sahneler.metin: During the Loma Prieta earthquake, a section of the Bay Bridge fell.
A car drove into the gap, and the driver was killed.
The upper deck dropped onto the lower deck.
Bolts holding the span sheared off.
The section slid off its support.
The bridge was closed for a month.
The eastern span was later replaced by a new seismic design.

aciklama:
Loma Prieta Bay Bridge dropped a section onto the deck below. The cause: failure of connections at a pier where the span slid off its support.
